subject: food-technology
title: Food Hygiene & HACCP: Foundations
welcome_lead: Learn the four basic rules that keep food safe — the 4 Cs.
meta_desc: GCSE food hygiene foundations: 4 Cs, bacteria conditions, danger zone.
final_note: Get the 4 Cs right and most food poisoning never starts.

concepts.def: Microbes that can multiply and cause illness.
Food bacteria thrive in, e.g. cooked meat.
Clean hands, hair tied, no jewellery in food prep.

walkthroughs.body_html: Bacteria need warmth, moisture, time and food to multiply. The danger zone is roughly 5 °C to 63 °C. Below 5 °C they barely grow; above 63 °C most die. Cool food fast and keep hot food hot.
The four food-safety pillars: Cleaning surfaces and hands; thorough Cooking (core 75 °C); rapid Chilling below 5 °C; and preventing Cross-contamination between raw and ready-to-eat foods.

High-risk foods are moist, protein-rich and ready to eat — cooked meat, dairy, cooked rice, soft cheese, shellfish. They need extra care: stored chilled, used within use-by dates, and never re-heated more than once.
